versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Weather courtiers whose units make extra attacks out of turn (Gusts), counted as the Gale.
The Gale pays out in the shop as gold, permanent stats and items; some courtiers skip attacks so one favourite strikes again.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Sir Vane gets a tiebreak for mirrors, and Lady High Pressure no longer makes the favourite Defer, so the Favourite build works as written.
Smaller wording fixes: Föhn soaks Bristle too, Thunderhead and Wild Hunt fire at "or more", and the Gust keyword says what a cycle is.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
